profile.headline: Software Engineer I at Walmart Labs

positions.title: Cloud Security Developer
positions.description:
Created a factory for images that were secure by Adobe standards, that could be used to create Docker containers
Used Ruby on Rails to create a website that allowed users to access secure images and create new images
Wrote scripts that created images based on user specifications and saved them to JFrog Artifactory

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Worked in an artificial intelligence and robotics lab on machine learning with the Baxter robot
Created convex polygon models of train set for Baxter robot to interact with
Coded and ran trials to evaluate the efficiency of vision, edge detection, and planning algorithms
Calibrated RGB and depth camera for Kinect
Used SVM training algorithms to train Baxter robot to better detect if a light was red or green.

company.name: Department of Computer Science, University of Maryland

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Front-end web development for Regional Integrated Transportation Information System (RITIS) and RITIS Meeting using HTML/CSS and JavaScript
Back-end web development using PHP with the Symfony framework and PostgreSQL

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Determined that there was not an association between the L162V polymorphism on the PPARα gene and LDL cholesterol levels in obese children
